Completed batch 57’s four draft items, both pages, manifest, coverage, proof contracts, cross-batch dependency records, notes, and current non-owner Step 1 readiness records. The A page is [tgr-mc04](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/library/thermodynamics-and-general-relativity-mathematics/tgr-mc04.md); the B page is [tgr-mc04-examples](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/library/thermodynamics-and-general-relativity-mathematics/tgr-mc04-examples.md).

During review, I replaced the Cattaneo positivity estimate’s least-eigenvalue bound with a componentwise bound using the temperature term \(C|\widehat\theta_k|^2\). This keeps the explicit estimate consistent with the stated SI units. The proof contract and manifest now match the revised statement.

Scoped checks passed: precheck (3 proof items), proof layout (4 items, 18 steps), strict proof contracts (4/4), rendering (6 files), dependency checks (4 items; 1,340 closure items and 232 pages), content policy, source retrieval (4/4), and manifest integrity (160/160 pages). All four Step 1 records are current and ready; those records are not independent proof approval.

Two owner-level dependencies remain open:

- The page edge `tgr-mc04 → tgr-mc03` remains open because MC03’s upstream MC02 page dependency is unresolved. The exact edge and evidence are in the [cross-batch record](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-remaining-80-2026-10-17-batch-57.cross-batch-dependencies.json).

Batch 56 remains level 2 and batch 57 level 3, with no cycle; changed prerequisite rows are in batches 22, 46, and 47. I left the shared receipt for the owner to refresh after writers drain.
